summary: Comprehensive testing of BRUNO Social Feed feature. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working - Feed tab, Create Post, Like, Comments, Explore tab. Fixed 1 bug in create_comment endpoint (User model has 'name' not 'username').
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in server.py line 2439: User model has 'name' attribute, not 'username'. Changed current_user.username to current_user.name
Posts API correctly enriches posts with user info (username, avatar_url, display_name, is_verified)
Like toggle correctly increments/decrements likes_count and creates notifications
Comments correctly update post's comments_count and include user info in response
FeedPage.jsx properly handles both social feed and cards explorer tabs
PostCard.jsx correctly implements like toggle, comments section, and delete functionality
CreatePost.jsx supports text, image, video posts and card sharing
seed_data_creation: Created test posts during testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Social feed feature fully tested and working. Bug fixed in create_comment endpoint. All CRUD operations for posts, likes, and comments verified via pytest. UI tested with Playwright - create post, like, comment, tab switching all work correctly.

social_feed_tab.details: Feed tab shows posts with user info, like count, comment count. data-testid='social-tab-btn' works

create_post.details: CreatePost component visible for logged in users. Can create text posts. Post appears in feed immediately

post_display.details: Posts show username/display_name, avatar, timestamp, content, like count, comment count, share and bookmark buttons

like_functionality.details: Heart icon toggles like state. Like count updates correctly. Backend API tested with toggle verification

comments_section.details: Clicking comment icon shows/hides comments section. Shows 'No hay comentarios' when empty

add_comment.details: Logged in users can add comments. Comment appears immediately. User info shown with comment

explore_tab.details: Explore tab shows cards grid with search, filters (All, Personal, Corporate, Business, Places, Guardian, Resume), Grid/List toggle. data-testid='cards-tab-btn' works

test_classes: TestPostsAPI (6 tests) - GET public, GET authenticated, CREATE, CREATE+verify persistence, GET single, DELETE
TestLikesAPI (2 tests) - like post, like toggle
TestCommentsAPI (2 tests) - get comments, create comment
TestPostsWithMedia (1 test) - create post with media
TestUnauthorizedAccess (3 tests) - create post, like, comment without auth

bug_fixed.fix: Changed current_user.username to current_user.name (User model has 'name' not 'username')
bug_fixed.impact: create_comment endpoint was crashing with 520 error
